description: just verify implementer (scripts/verify.nu) classifies test-file-touched from the tracked diff only: a NEW untracked test file (e.g. crates/seeds/tests/dedupe.rs, run 01M324AZVMHDSCSAMVP4WTZR1R) is invisible to it, so it runs only a compile check and skips the crate suite; implementers must apply the policy manually (cargo nextest run -p <crate>) whenever they add a test file that git does not yet track.
resolution: Manual: run cargo nextest run -p <crate> for any crate whose test files were added but are still untracked; durable fix belongs in scripts/verify.nu diff derivation (include untracked files).

description: Fabro line silent overnight = check in this order: (1) GET /api/v1/automations/<id> — the scheduler SELF-DISABLES the schedule trigger after 3 consecutive failed fires (confirmed live 2026-09-22: three seeds-6eb8 capability-block deadlocks at 02:00/02:30/03:00 killed conductor-seeds); (2) rootprint service_name:fabro automation_scheduler timeline (stall watchdog fabro-79d8 reports missed_slots); (3) rootprint severity ERROR for the run ids — planner failure_reason texts are complete there; (4) stranded work check: git diff <merge-base>..origin/fabro/run/<id> — failed runs push their branch, soft_stop runs can contain complete implementations (01M32Q6D: full seeds-a9e7 work survived, only closeout missing). Re-enable only after queue curation: PUT automations/<id> with allowed fields + If-Match revision, flip triggers[schedule].enabled.
resolution: Curate queue first (close done seeds, assign sandbox-executable work), then PUT-re-enable; capability-block seeds must route HITL (seeds-a77c) instead of deadlock

description: A .fabro/workflows/*/workflow.fabro edit must satisfy THREE parsers, and they disagree: (1) the mirtuell server 0.361 automation packager parses with the old fabro-graphviz nom parser - attribute keys are identifier/qualified_id ONLY, quoted keys like "human.question"= hard-fail every fire at packaging; (2) the tester qualitygate arm (scripts/qualitygate.nu:173) runs graphviz dot -Tcanon which REJECTS unquoted dotted keys; (3) fabro validate (petri) accepts both spellings but models DIFFERENT attributes than the fabro 0.361 engine (it flags skills/fs_write/kind that run fine server-side, and does not know fabro-only semantics). Consequence: no single spelling of a dotted attr key passes server+graphviz, and a green local fabro validate proves nothing about server packaging. Hit 2026-09-22: PR #35 landed the needs_operator gate with invented attrs (human.question/options/freeform/timeout_seconds exist in NO engine rev) in quoted spelling - every conductor fire failed silently for 5h (packaging errors do NOT trip the 3-strike breaker; only fabro automations status fire-drift reveals it). Diagnosis method that worked: build the exact server-rev parser in a git worktree (git worktree add /tmp/fabro-0361 6e9be17e1; scratch crate path-depending on lib/components/fabro-graphviz; call parser::parse) - it reproduced the server error byte-for-byte and proved the fix before pushing. Real human-gate model (fabro 0.361 AND petri): question text = node label; options = outgoing edges ([S]/[P] labels, bracket prefix is the accelerator key); freeform=true on an edge; deadline = timeout=86400s; human.default_choice names a target. Restore of default_choice needs the gate-parse arms reconciled first (revisor finding #2, .fabro/reviews/develop/01M33WZF2KMHMP9W8RPJ0SB5X2.md).
resolution: seeds-800d operator repair landed 0f45580: gate rewritten to the real engine model (node label = question, [S]/[P] option edges, freeform=true edge flag, timeout=86400s), all dotted human.* attrs dropped; verified against the exact 0.361 server parser via worktree harness before push; fire 01M34FR7W0P1Z4WRT414Q57B0M packaged 6 nodes/17 edges and restored the line. Permanent fix (default_choice restore) blocked on reconciling qualitygate dot -Tcanon arm with the server packager - tracked in seeds-800d body.

name: cap-walk-included-after-emit
description: In budgeted diff walks (evidence.nu diff-walk, seeds-731d): append a file to the 'included/walked' set only AFTER the cost check passes and the chunk is emitted. The original code appended before the cap check, so the file that tripped the cap was silently dropped from the omitted-list disclosure — the exact 'no file silently dropped' invariant the disclosure exists to enforce. General rule: in any cap/budget loop, bookkeeping that drives the cut-report must be updated in the same branch that emits, not the branch that visits.
